title: my mallworld notes from 2019
content: yes I was in gate yes I go here frequently yes it has changed since then... but here are my phone notes from six years ago yw 7 December 2019 The repetitive one. Same indescribable feelings. Day time. (Parking?) in the woods, crossing a road to the (lake side?) of the road. (3?) different times after parking there. Avoiding cars. Stepping over a small cable fence so as not to trip. Gravel. On Lake Road after passing intersection between Districts 8, 6, & 5 on the way to Districts 2 & 7. The feelings when I wake up are so similar to every other time. What are these feelings? It's quite deep. A physical feeling when I wake up. The plants look similar. There is exposed dirt along the roads in the mountains and hills. It's red up on the brushy hills and a yellow granite colour along Lake Road. There is coniferous forrest everywhere, ocean to mountains. There is a lot of brush and dirt roads and country roads. It rains. It floods. It snows. There are nice days and evenings. Sunny but still cool. Do I need to be doing something or going anywhere in this repetition? I've walked and driven and floated and flown over this world for like ten years now in my dreams. Trains: Sometimes I'm on the train. In District 0 going to school or the airport. It's a narrow subway that looks like it's from the 80s. It's a blue and white older train. The tracks underground have curves and inclines. I'm usually on a small platform waiting for the train to come up out of a tunnel. There's dirty white tiles or bricks on the walls. Missed flight: Missing a flight over and over. Usually because I forget and can't make it on time. It's usually to Canada or whatever my condition is of a northern journey across a giant continent. Karen and Stevie are there sometimes, in the airports and on the planes. Schools A lot of times I'm failing at school due to anxiety about even going and at one point in the repetition I just said fuck it who cares I'm not gonna graduate with everyone and then I rarely had that dream since. The school changes. There's a nice multistory one by the harbor. Ones in other [ocean town] settings that remind me of elementary and middle schools irL. Climbing over bookshelves. Frantic trying and failing. Mingyu was there at least once, the time I decided to give up. It's always that i've finished high school, gotten a real job and then gone back to high school and made friends but then can't graduate because I never went to class. Driving: This land has roads that give me anxiety. The ones that vastly connect everything. The freeways that feel familiar. Freeways over water and steep highways along the ocean. There's one (long way?) to the city (out of it?) that has a part that goes straight up with the ocean below and it's terrifying. Right before the car flips backwards to fall it curves down to run parallel to the water half a mile above the sea between all of these islands and man made floating cities. I'm not sure if this is the ocean or a giant bay. It looks very cold in places. Tropical in others. The vertical incline part is near the city and one of the only ways out of it towards (the north?) The city~ District 0 It's surrounded by water and only accessed from far away by freeways over the water. It's a large shiny bronze sphere of metal and asphalt floating a few stories above a sandy Island coast. A dock runs out from the land to underneath it. Trains can come out of it too, but I don't remember being on a train over the ocean, only on subways inside & mostly underground. Inside the sphere, it incomprehensibly folds in on itself in many layers. It's very empty. Transport can look like one of those wire lined ball tracks in a pinball machine due to the 3d nature of the city, winding like a mechanical waterslide. Gravity is always towards the ground you're standing on, even if technically you're not upright related to the outside world. The city reminds me of Paris sometimes. The bigger mall is there. Pretty sure the other districts exist in some state between inside and outside the sphere. I feel like more people live outside the sphere than inside. Even though the inside can house millions, barely anyone lives there. For me it's a place I go for work and dates I think. I'm not sure where I live except maybe the house with hidden rooms in District 10. I can't tell if this is inside or outside, just that it is connected through the mall concept. I think I lived in District 7 before it flooded. With David. District 1: There's that huge human statue ruin that fell half way into a small lake by the road & you can walk on the side of its lichen covered face. There is blue sky in the day and drunken stumbling across dirt lotsor brick floored town squares. The outer sea is on one side, it descends into District 3. A river runs along the other side of the lake road. District 2: The town where the land roads and freeways intersect On a hillside facing southwest. The old motels in the flat part. Dusty debris covered parking lots. It's at one end of the road that goes along a river to the lake (Lake Road) that has the ruins and to the curvy road hills past the lake. Can take the freeway to the city from here but it's scary. There are lots of overpasses, onramps & off-ramps. Sort of hilly. Thinned coniferous forrest surrounding until the sea becomes visible. Another way out goes to the place where the small mall was built. It became a university town and the house with hidden rooms is still there. District 3 (connected to District 1): The small coves with houses. Reeds? Pampas grass up the hills into the fog Dirt and paved roads Nice houses Gas station job down highway along coast House on the small cliff The small fields/alleys Main Street Long long highway along the coast for commute by old cars District 4: harbour town. It's always night here. It feels close to the lake road, District 9, and the mountain school with the flood. A river empties here that goes to into high mountains. It runs down a huge valley. District 5: The low woods ~ lake road and properties District 6: The high woods ~ colorful town with short houses. Dirt roads high up along ridges between properties. District 7: The lake ruins. A whole hillside town half submerged in water. Bad dreams here since 9 years ago. When you drive away towards District 2 along the river, the river takes a while to form from the vastness of the lake. Much of it looks like a canyon carved thru a gray stone quarry. There are large angular stone arches here, ancient ruins. They look like buttresses going into the water from the gray stone walls. They're fucking huge and more of a silhouette in the distance. It's rare to dream of standing directly under them. The road is far from them. The riverbed is all rounded gray stones. It's huge. The river looks like a trickle in the middle of it even though the river is huge. District 8: There's a low elevation town past the lake if you keep going away from it, away from the sea. It's hilly and brushy until you get there but I don't know it. I just have a vague image of the city lights spreading out against dark blue night. And the sense of coming from that way sometimes on my journeys. Maybe sitting in a car in a big parking lot there at sunset. District 9: The place by the rough sea. The movie theater? Tower? The place where it flooded into a restaurant but everyone was cool with it. The place with the hotels from those scary dreams. Can you get here from the lake ruins? How do you get here from the other places? Old asphalt parking lot. Another school. Mountain path. A floating dream along it. District 10: Student town with small mall The house with hidden rooms is here The strange tall university building above the mall, how it's all indoor. You enter and exit the buildings above the mall from inside the mall. It's big and airy and has one path through it with all kinds of classrooms, conference rooms, restaurants, living quarters etc above it. The always trying to travel north on land, south by the coast. Always on a journey? The inside of buildings and houses is the creepiest. The movie theaters and malls. In the snowy mountain school above District 4. In District 9 and in District 10. So much underwater. Flooding problems for thousands of years probably. Giant ancient stone ruins half submerged in the lake and in District 1. More ruins and an entire modern town in District 7. A present threat in District 4. Moderately in District 9 where it's used as an attraction. The restaurant where you can wade in and sit at a table with your lower body under the water. It's milky there. It's like walking at a festival in the sun while wading thru knee to hip high mineral bath water. Where is the mountain stream(s) I float over to the high places in the mountains. The waterfall and tableau festival. Rushing streams down the mountains. Wildflowers and cedar trees. Bright blue sky and patches of snow and melting icicles. It feels like it's in the East. If the Lake Road runs North to South, District 8 is the northern most point along the lake. Then districts 6, 5, 7 and 2 in that order moving south. Lake road keeps going south past this town. I vaguely remember it in the dark. The enclosing silhouette of tall forest trees on either side of a cold road. Another part of [this road?] is on the other side of the water but also close to the sea somehow. District 3 is along the sea. Going uphill away from the water from there you can go into District 1 by a certain road. District 1 lets out into a road along a river that turns into District 10 to the south. The first thing you come to when you get to District 10 is the intersection where the house with hidden rooms is on the corner lot. From District 2 you can travel to District 7, 5, 6 then 8 along the same highway towards the north and west. You can take a freeway south and West to the city (District 0.) Connects to the old version of District 10 along roads to the south and east. West then North over the steep water freeways shows a water metropolis I've only anxiously driven through. These freeways can take you to land, like a whole big continent free of so much water. Then you can do long distance travel to other areas in this world. There were salt flats and semi natural wave pools. District 3 is a highway stretch into a town. In the flat parts, this is as far as the document went. there are lots of things to add like those crazy bathrooms but I think this is what I had mapped out at the time I do have several drawings like chicken scratch maps but idk how to add them here
